column1: # Tab-separated, "-" = empty (tabs collapse in bash `read`, so a bare empty field would shift columns).
#   backends     comma list of backends its build.sh accepts (HIP is UNTESTED everywhere: no ROCm)
#   timeout_s    default hard limit for a clean run; the profiled run gets 3x
#   fom_*        the metric the application prints itself; "-" in all five when it prints none.
#                fom_regex: python regex with exactly one capture group, the LAST match wins;
#                a case may override it (level2_cases.tsv) because some FOM lines depend on the case
#   extra_env    input variables a case may set beyond those run.sh reads (normally "-")
#   roi_excludes what HPCPERF_ROI_EXCLUDE_* carves out INSIDE the ROI ("-" = nothing); set-up,
#                warm-up, final checks and final output are simply outside the ROI
#   notes        free text; for applications without a FOM, what they print instead
# The FOM is read from the CLEAN run (no profiler). The ROI -- not the FOM's own denominator --
# defines the measured time; the two can differ (quicksilver's FOM covers cycleTracking only).
